mcq_fix.why: drop odd 'As per the APPSC key' wording; answer per y9819dfb2532

mcq_drop.why: A-R link debatable (R describes Mahayana, arguably explains A); ambiguous key

patterns: APPSC asks the Shaka-Kushana dress item (trousers, long coat, helmet, boots; turban excluded) and I-tsing on Suhrllekha.
Other PSCs repeat: Fourth Council under Kanishka in Kashmir presided by Vasumitra; court scholars (Patanjali/Vishakhadatta not); first large-scale gold = Vima Kadphises; Buddha on Kanishka's coins.
Traps: Kujula = copper vs Vima = gold; Pan Chao defeated Kanishka; Rabatak omits Shravasti; Yaudheya coins show Kartikeya.
App closely matches PYQ facts, with extra Rabatak/coinage statement sets; minor 'how many' counts.
